title: Lifted frequency is perpendicular
statement: Let $H$ be a subspace of the binary cube $\bbr_2^n$, and let a binary subspace split identify that cube linearly with $H$ times a complementary binary cube. For every frequency $\gamma$ in the complementary cube, its lift to the original cube belongs to the perpendicular subspace of $H$.
hypotheses_covered: A subspace $H$ of the binary cube of dimension $n$
A frequency $\gamma$ in the complementary binary cube
